import sys

it = iter(sys.stdin.read().split())


def I():
    return int(next(it))


def S():
    return next(it)


n = I()
s = S()
runs = []
i = 0
days = n
while i < n:
    if s[i] == "0":
        i += 1
        continue
    j = i
    while j < n and s[j] == "1":
        j += 1
    length = j - i
    runs.append(length)
    days = min(days, length - 1 if i == 0 or j == n else (length - 1) // 2)
    i = j
width = 2 * days + 1
print(sum((length + width - 1) // width for length in runs))
approach: 每个连续感染段约束传播天数，边界段允许单侧传播；取最大的统一可行天数，再求覆盖每段需要多少初始感染源。
